query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM qs_user_record u
                    WHERE u.user_id = $1
                        AND u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM qs_client_record c
                            WHERE c.user_id = u.user_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
                        )
                ) AS "is_drained!"
